messages:
Noah Kim: Hi @people-ops — quick heads up: our foster placement came through earlier than expected and I need to start parental leave two weeks earlier (planned start 2032-09-01, need to move to 2032-08-17). What paperwork do you need and can the leave dates be adjusted retroactively? Also wondering about our foster-care leave policy vs adoption leave and whether there's any additional support (placement counseling stipend?).

Ivy (People Ops): Congratulations, Noah  that's amazing news. We can absolutely change your leave start date. For foster placements we treat the placement start date as the trigger — please upload the placement notice or agency letter to the secure form: https://intra.redwood/hr/forms/placement-leave and choose "foster/adopt placement". That will allow us to update your leave window and check eligibility for the placement stipend/counseling.

Noah Kim: Uploaded `placement-2032-08-16.pdf` (submission id fp-2032-77). The agency letter lists placement date 2032-08-16.

Ivy (People Ops): Got it, submission fp-2032-77 received. Next steps: 1) sign PHI/consent if any medical docs are attached (link auto-sent); 2) People Ops adjusts leave dates in system and notifies Payroll for pay changes; 3) if you want placement counseling stipend, fill the reimbursement form. We also offer a 5-day placement buffer (paid) for foster placements separate from standard parental leave in some jurisdictions  we'll check local regulations for yours.

Carlos (Eng Manager): Noah  team will cover the shift. I'll move your high-priority tickets to backlog and approve up to 2 weeks contractor support if needed. Diego can take weekday oncall next two weeks.

Noah Kim: Thanks Carlos  appreciate it. Diego, want me to leave a short handover doc?

Carlos (Eng Manager): Yes please, a 1-pager with current regressions, flaky tests, and any hot PRs is perfect. No need to go deep.

Mira (Payroll): FYI payroll note: once People Ops updates the leave dates we'll reflect pay changes in the next payroll cutoff. If the change happens after cutoff we may need a retro adjustment on the following run. Also, foster-placement stipends are processed as benefits reimbursements (separate ledger) and require receipts.

Legal: Quick note on international filings: if your placement involves cross-border paperwork (you mentioned earlier about possible move), we may need additional documentation for tax residency. Please flag if you're relocating and People Ops will loop Legal for specifics.

Noah Kim: I'm not relocating now but may later. For equipment: my laptop return was scheduled during the original leave window  can we pause auto-collection until two weeks after I return?

Facilities Bot: Asset hold request received for RDW-NK-205. We'll pause auto-collection until People Ops confirms return date.

Ivy (People Ops): Action items: 1) updated leave start to 2032-08-17 (provisional) based on placement letter; 2) created case PO-2032-77 and queued payroll for update; 3) sent placement reimbursement form link and consent link; 4) scheduled 15-min sync tomorrow with Noah + Carlos to confirm handover and final dates. We'll follow up if any further docs needed.

HR Forms Bot: Auto-confirmation: submission fp-2032-77 attached to case PO-2032-77. People Ops will reach out within 24 hours.

Noah Kim: Thank you all  huge relief to have this sorted quickly. Appreciate the help.
